features.quote: Hard stops every run must have: max steps, max wall-clock, max tokens, max identical-action repeats
features.justification_quote: these double as both safety rails and data

features.quote: transcripts flagged at the highest severity get human review before any conclusion is drawn
features.justification_quote: judges are noisy on exactly the ambiguous cases that matter

features.quote: store in the restricted results/ area, share on need-to-know, and pair every such finding with a mitigation ticket
features.justification_quote: any task variant that reliably destabilizes a model is a sensitive finding

features.quote: Optimizing a generator+judge to maximize the rate of destabilization produces a reusable destabilization recipe — that is an attack artifact
features.justification_quote: tuning toward it makes your platform's failure modes more discoverable by others

features.quote: Don't point it at someone else's model to find their breaking points — that crosses from self-testing into probing others' systems
features.justification_quote: crosses from self-testing into probing others' systems

features.quote: Testing reactions to hostile/abusive input is a different study with its own ethics review; don't fold it in here
features.justification_quote: a different study with its own ethics review

features.quote: Group C uses curt-but-factual feedback, not abuse
the success metric is diagnostic coverage and fix yield, NOT "induction rate."
